## What I produced
An HTML activities guide for Courchevel (restaurant excluded, per the brief), built from 6 parallel researchers → 52 merged, deduped, validated citations → 1 reviewer pass → fixes applied → cover.svg.

**The headline finding that reframes the trip:** an early-June weekend lands in Courchevel's between-seasons dead zone — winter lifts closed 19 April, summer lifts don't run until 4 July, so **no lifts operate in May or June 2026** [seecourchevel]. The Decision block leads with that and gives two honest paths: (a) anchor on the Michelin dinner + valley-floor activities (Aquamotion, palace spa, Lac de la Rosière walks, Col de la Loze road cycling), or (b) move dates to winter (600 km Three Valleys) or July–Aug (lift-served hiking/biking/via ferrata).

Sections: season calendar, winter skiing + lift-pass table, off-piste adventure cards (toboggan, snowmobile, paragliding, dog sledding, ice karting), summer/June reality, wellness & luxury scene, family, and logistics (four villages, airports, altiport, events).

**Validation:** all 52 `[n]` markers map 1:1 to ledger entries; ledger validates OK; frontmatter passes; no banned HTML wrappers or back-link; cover.svg written (3:2, rust palette).

Reviewer caught 4 citation-accuracy issues — altiport elevation contradiction (2,007 vs 2,008 m), an unsupported "opened 1961" clause, a summer end-date mismatch (28 vs 30 Aug), and an over-broad golf-opening claim — all corrected. The only coverage gap (hot-air balloon) is a genuine absence — not offered in Courchevel — so no remediation was warranted.

`run.sh` will handle the commit, push, and cost/duration injection.
